name: Mafiosi III: Cosa Nostra
source:
Mafiosi: Cosa Nostra is the third kinetic novel about a mafia family known as the Gallos. The story is told through the eyes of the men and women of the Gallo family, who range from the ages of 19-32, as they rise to power in a gigantic crime syndicate. 

The story begins 8 years after Mafiosi: Famiglia Cosa. The year is 1997 in New York city. Kevin Gallo is now at the head of the Gallo family, and once again finds himself at odds with rivaling crime families. With the help of his fellow family members, he aims to take back the Gallos’ place at the head of the mafia crime syndicate. However, after a series of escalating circumstances, the Gallo family members themselves slowly begin to turn on each other. This will prove to be the bloodiest and most exciting story yet!
